verdict: Google went dark and leads have dried up — here's what's being fixed.
narrative: This period delivered 20 leads at a cost of $148.21 each, but the last five days (July 26–30) produced zero leads — a confirmed drought, not a data gap. Google Ads, which consumed $2,326.12 of the $2,964.20 total spend this period, stopped delivering entirely on July 29–30, leaving your budget idle while Meta carried the full load on its own. Meta leads also fell 83% week-over-week, and Google Business Profile engagement dropped 45% in the same stretch, which points to a broader demand or visibility issue beyond paid alone. Google is being brought back online and conversion tracking is being confirmed this week to ensure every lead is captured going forward. Once Google is active and verified, cost per lead should return toward prior-period levels.
